lines: Revenue was $23.3 million, up 27% year over year.
A record 115,000 analyses were performed, up 22% year over year; U.S. analysis volume grew 60% and Liquid Biopsy revenue grew 80%.
IFRS net loss was $22.4 million; adjusted EBITDA loss improved 27% to $8.8 million.
2026 revenue guidance was raised to $94-$96 million, with adjusted EBITDA loss guidance of $29-$32 million.
